title: test-bm configuration
description: Per-bookmarklet test configuration for test-bm.js. Each key is a bookmarklet name, which is the file name in JSFormatted without its .js. A bookmarklet with no entry gets the default safe run: example.com, one run, a settle period, and a pass when it parsed, ran and threw nothing.

$schema.description: Points at this file, so an editor offers completion and validation.

entry.description: What a run does with one bookmarklet.

url.description: The page to open. Defaults to https://example.com/, which is reserved for documentation.

scheduled.description: Include this entry in node test-bm.js --scheduled. Only for pages that load headless with no consent wall and no bot check.

requires.description: The CSS selectors the bookmarklet reads, taken from its source rather than from memory. Each is checked before the bookmarklet runs, and a missing one fails with "site changed: <selector> not found on <url>".

steps.description: What to do on the page, in order. The bookmarklet runs once: at the step that names it, or after load when no step does.

dialogs.description: Answers to alert, confirm and prompt, in the order they appear. A dialog with no answer left is dismissed.

permissions.description: Browser permissions the context grants, such as clipboard-read and clipboard-write. An expect on a clipboard value needs clipboard-read.

skip.description: A reason to list the entry as skipped without running it. A skip never fails a run.
examples: the page needs a signed-in session

timeout.description: Milliseconds the whole entry is allowed, after which it fails.

settle.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last step, for anything the bookmarklet started.

step.description: One thing to do. Exactly one of run, click, fill, press, wait or expect.

run.description: Run the bookmarklet here, rather than after load. A second run step runs it again, which is how a bookmarklet that turns itself off on the second run is checked.

fill.description: A selector to type into, with the value beside it or nested in an object.

press.description: A key to press, such as Enter or Control+c. With a selector beside it, the key goes to that element.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait, or a selector to wait for.

selector.description: The element a press goes to.

value.description: The value a fill types, when fill is written as a selector on its own.

text.description: The value a fill types, written the other way round.

expect.description: What should be true. A selector that is visible or hidden, matches a count, or holds some text; or a clipboard value.

hidden.description: The first match is not showing.

count.description: How many elements the selector matches, exactly.

text.description: Text the first match holds somewhere in it.

clipboard.description: What the clipboard holds, trimmed at both ends. Needs clipboard-read in permissions.

accept.description: Accept it rather than dismissing it.

text.description: What to type into a prompt before accepting it.
